items.reasons: It is drawn as a flat front view. The cabinet roof has no lit top plane, and the seat is a red handbag-like blob stuck on the lower front panel instead of a seat seen from above. At 1x the steering wheel and the seat are an unreadable red smear, and the yellow coin slot on the control deck is a stray sticker-like highlight.

It is a flat front view of a backboard with belts and bags. The top is only a 1–2 px plank with no lit top surface, and the shelves show no depth. In the room it straddles the wall/floor seam with no believable ground line or wall mount, so it reads as a floating panel rather than a fixture standing on the floor or hanging on the wall.
